name: Karoline Herfurth
bio: Karoline Herfurth is a German actress, director and screenwriter. She is best known for appearing in the film Perfume: The Story of a Murderer (2006), as well as The Reader (2008). She is further known for appearing in German comedic films such as Girls on Top (2001) , Suck Me Shakespeer (2013) and We are the Night (2010).
